title: Industrial Sheds in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers builds factory, dairy, poultry, workshop and crane sheds across Pakistan. Wide-span steel sheds designed, fabricated and erected by one team.
h1: Industrial Sheds in Pakistan: Steel Sheds for Production, Farming and Heavy Work
quickAnswer: An industrial shed is a large steel building that gives covered space for production, storage, animals or machines. Steel Mind Engineers designs the shed, makes the steel in Lahore and erects it on your site anywhere in Pakistan.
alt: Aerial view of steel industrial sheds built in Pakistan.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a shed?
faq.a: It depends on the size and the foundation. The factory and the foundation work run at the same time, so the shed is ready sooner than a concrete one. The engineer will give a schedule with the quote.

faq.q: Can a shed have closed walls?
faq.a: Yes. Sheds can be fully sheeted, partly open or open on all sides.

blocks.text: An industrial shed is a large steel building with a simple roof and open or lightly closed walls. It gives covered space for production, storage, animals or machines. Steel Mind Engineers designs the shed for your use, makes the steel in its Lahore factory and erects it on your site.

Factory Sheds are production halls and plants. Dairy Farm Sheds are covered housing for cattle. Poultry Sheds are controlled houses for birds. Workshop Sheds are repair and fabrication bays. Crane Sheds are sheds with overhead cranes. Steel Mind Engineers also builds feed storage sheds, milking parlour sheds, godown sheds, truck and loading sheds, parking sheds, boiler and generator sheds, and textile mill sheds.
Steel sheds go up quickly, cover wide areas and can be extended. They also cost less to maintain than many other building types. Steel Mind Engineers uses the PEB system for most sheds.

Steel Mind Engineers built a 96,600 square foot crane shed for Haier at Raiwind and a 39,330 square foot dairy shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. It also built a 22,000 square foot dairy shed for Latifia Dairy at Kasur. See Our Projects.
